title: Problem adding treatment with more than 2 decimal
body: **Problem:** When adding a treatment with 3 or more decimal places, the last 2 or 3 are considered as units of insulin: + 3.125 » 25 units + 0.148 » 48 units + 1.2563 » 563 units (the same for carbs with specific differences) Not a major problem, but a user reported his son was instroducing values like this taking a huge imapact in what he was receiving as a follower I think the problem is at Simulation.class `private void createTreatment(String allWords) { allWords = allWords.replaceAll("([0-9].[0-9])([0-9][0-9])", "$1 $2"); }` **Suggestions:** + Assuming we want a maximum of 2 decimal places (truncate) `allWords = allWords.replaceAll("([0-9].[0-9]^{0,2})([0-9]?)([0-9]?)","$1")` _or_ `allWords = allWords.replaceAll("([0-9].[0-9][0-9])([0-9]?)([0-9]?)", "$1");` + Accepting all decimal places `allWords = allWords.replaceAll("([0-9].[0-9])([0-9]))", "$1");` All help and suggestions will be more than welcome. Thank you
